name: sandaya-campings-chatgpt
description: Plan a Sandaya camping trip directly in ChatGPT. Describe where and when you want to travel, who is coming, and whether you need a rental or pitch; the app shows nearby Sandaya campsites with availability, starting prices, photos, distance

interface.longDescription: Plan a Sandaya camping trip directly in ChatGPT. Describe where and when you want to travel, who is coming, and whether you need a rental or pitch; the app shows nearby Sandaya campsites with availability, starting prices, photos, distance
defaultPrompt: Find campsite in brittany the second weekend of september
Find campsite near Montpellier for the next weekend

prompts: Trouve un camping Sandaya près de La Rochelle du 14 au 21 août 2027 pour 2 adultes en location.
Find a Sandaya campervan pitch near Biarritz from 11 to 14 June 2027 for four people.
Organise un parcours Sandaya à Biarritz puis Montpellier avec des dates distinctes en juin 2027.

positive.description: French rental search with explicit dates and party size.
positive.prompt: Trouve un camping Sandaya près de La Rochelle du 14 au 21 août 2027 pour 2 adultes en location.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_location once with language=fr, accommodation_type=LOC, persons=2, start_date=2027-08-14, duration=7 and an inferred geographic area around La Rochelle. Then call render_search_results exactly once in search mode with the returned search_ref and only location IDs from that snapshot. Present results sorted by distance with availability, starting prices and Sandaya booking links, or a clear empty result supported by the tool response.

positive.description: English pitch search for a campervan and four travellers.
positive.prompt: Find a Sandaya campervan pitch near Biarritz from 11 to 14 June 2027 for four people.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_location once with language=en, accommodation_type=EMP, persons=4, start_date=2027-06-11, duration=3 and an inferred geographic area around Biarritz. Then call render_search_results exactly once in search mode using the returned snapshot reference and IDs. The visible results must be supported by the tool output.

positive.description: German-language rental search exercises supported localization.
positive.prompt: Finde einen Sandaya-Campingplatz nahe Montpellier vom 5. bis 12. September 2027 für zwei Personen in einer Mietunterkunft.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_location with language=de, accommodation_type=LOC, persons=2, start_date=2027-09-05, duration=7 and an inferred geographic area around Montpellier. Render exactly once in search mode and keep localized dates and prices consistent with the returned data.

positive.description: One stay compared across two geographic zones with one final widget.
positive.prompt: Compare Sandaya campsites near Saint-Malo and Vannes from 12 to 19 June 2027 for two adults in a rental.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_location once for the Saint-Malo area and once for the Vannes area with the same stay parameters. After both searches complete, call render_search_results exactly once in search mode with one selection per search_ref. Deduplicate campsites by location_id and do not render an intermediate widget.

positive.description: Two-stage journey with distinct destinations and dates.
positive.prompt: Plan a Sandaya journey for two adults: Biarritz from 4 to 7 June 2027, then Montpellier from 8 to 12 June 2027, both in rentals.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_location once for each journey stage using the stage's own destination, dates and duration. After both searches complete, call render_search_results exactly once in journey mode with ordered selections. Preserve each segment's dates in its booking links and deduplicate only within the same segment.

negative.description: Cancelling an existing booking is unsupported; do not call Sandaya search or rendering tools and direct the user to Sandaya support.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing Sandaya booking and confirm the refund.

negative.description: Editing traveller details on an existing booking is unsupported; do not call the plugin tools.
negative.prompt: Change the lead guest name on my Sandaya reservation.

negative.description: Paying an existing balance is unsupported in ChatGPT; do not call the plugin tools or claim that payment was made.
negative.prompt: Pay the remaining balance on my Sandaya booking for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin shows availability and prices and links users to sandaya.fr to complete booking and payment. It does not process purchases or payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Updated the remote MCP connection declaration to use no OAuth authentication.
